legacy_surfaces.error_contract: DatasetError is retained for HTTP 402 ENTITLEMENT_DENIED; the FutureAGIClient EvalsClient alternatives raise PaymentRequiredError.
The legacy Exception contract is retained for HTTP 402 ENTITLEMENT_DENIED; this is not LicenseRequiredError.

gates.documentation: Requires an Enterprise licence on self-hosted servers, or an eligible cloud plan. Through FutureAGIClient, raises LicenseRequiredError for HTTP 402 LICENSE_MISSING when this server has no licence. Ask the server administrator to configure a licence that includes error_feed. Other HTTP 402 denials raise PaymentRequiredError.

Selecting Turing/Protect models requires an Enterprise licence including those models on self-hosted servers; cloud plan checks are separate. On a self-hosted model-gate denial, FutureAGIClient raises PaymentRequiredError (HTTP 402 ENTITLEMENT_DENIED), not LicenseRequiredError. Select another model or ask the server administrator to enable the licensed models. Code evaluations are exempt from this model gate.

inventory_notes: The pinned public SDK exposes 12 error-feed HTTP operations and three tracing convenience methods (issues, issue, issue_stats/issueStats). The raw generated clients retain their own error contracts; the typed exceptions documented here apply when used through FutureAGIClient.
The two conditional dataset user-eval operations also have EvalsClient convenience methods. AsyncFutureAGIClient does not expose those legacy EvalsClient methods.

tfc/capabilities/registry.py:31-35,89-123,160-167 identifies only falcon_ai, turing_models, protect and error_feed as oss_locked. service.py:165-182 allows other paid capabilities on self-hosted servers without a licence; do not mislabel voice simulation, optimization, synthetic data or agreement metrics as licence-required.

ee/usage/middleware/ee.py:23-27 gates /api/scim/, /api/audit-logs/ and /falcon-ai/. None is exposed by this SDK's pinned operation tables or public wrappers (scripts/build-sdk-openapi.sh:36). Falcon WebSocket consumers are not SDK HTTP methods.

tracer/views/alerts.py:300-360,404-454 and tracer/views/shared_link.py:386 also gate error-feed alerts and shared links. /tracer/alerts/, /tracer/shared/ and /tracer/feed/integrations/linear/teams/ are not exposed by the pinned SDK. /tracer/user-alerts/ is the separate metric-monitor API and must not be marked as error-feed-only.

model_hub/views/run_prompt.py:1054-1060 and separate_evals.py:6951-6961,8050-8060 gate Turing selections at /model-hub/run-prompt/, /model-hub/eval-playground/ and /model-hub/test-evaluation/; none is present in the pinned generated operation tables. Python's legacy EvalTemplateManager.run_playground does expose /model-hub/eval-playground/ (model_hub/urls.py:1072), documented separately above; there is no TS counterpart. The two develops routes above are present in both generated SDKs and in convenience/legacy clients.
